# Verify adjective-order options against precedence constraints inferred from the
# 208-line list. EVID is a hand-picked sample of the list, so the closure is a
# lower bound: more evidence could only resolve UNKNOWN verdicts, not reverse FAILs.

CAT = {}
for cat_name, words in [
    ("material", "plastic steel fiberglass wool cloth leather paper glass cardboard rubber iron wood"),
    ("age", "old ancient archaic brand-new new old-fashioned"),
    ("opinion", "obnoxious awful silly repulsive ridiculous mysterious wonderful nice lovely good terrible"),
    ("origin", "nigerian iranian thai brazilian vietnamese pakistani russian filipino american chinese "
               "ethiopian congolese mexican indian german egyptian indonesian japanese turkish bangladeshi"),
    ("purpose", "walking driving smoking snorkeling drinking eating hiking typing whittling exercise"),
    ("color", "indigo aqua violet blue cyan magenta white yellow gray red pink brown maroon green black crimson"),
    ("shape", "pyramidal prismlike spherical rectangular square circular triangular"),
    ("size", "little medium-size midsize small enormous large tiny huge massive big normal-size"),
]:
    for w in words.split():
        CAT[w] = cat_name

# Sampled adjective sequences taken from the list (head noun omitted).
EVID = [
    "glass wonderful gray",        # material < opinion < color
    "triangular tiny",             # shape < size
    "archaic leather",             # age < material
    "silly russian",               # opinion < origin
    "typing yellow",               # purpose < color
    "archaic russian hiking",      # age < origin < purpose
    "old paper",                   # age < material
    "spherical midsize",           # shape < size
    "repulsive vietnamese",        # opinion < origin
    "whittling cyan",              # purpose < color
]

edges = set()
for seq in EVID:
    cs = [CAT[w] for w in seq.split()]
    for a, b in zip(cs, cs[1:]):
        if a != b:
            edges.add((a, b))
changed = True
while changed:
    changed = False
    for (a, b) in list(edges):
        for (c, d) in list(edges):
            if b == c and a != d and (a, d) not in edges:
                edges.add((a, d))
                changed = True

cycle = [(a, b) for (a, b) in edges if (b, a) in edges]
print("constraint edges:", sorted(edges))
print("CHECK PASS: constraints consistent" if not cycle else f"CHECK FAIL: cycle {cycle}")

OPTIONS = {
    "A": "obnoxious nigerian walking indigo pyramidal medium-size car",
    "B": "little prismlike awful iranian smoking white bed",
    "C": "old steel obnoxious thai driving aqua box",
    "D": "old-fashioned plastic obnoxious brazilian drinking violet midsize spherical pen",
    "E": "rectangular small ridiculous nigerian snorkeling blue fiberglass ancient hat",
    "F": "wool silly vietnamese whittling cyan square enormous dog",
    "G": "old cloth repulsive iranian snorkeling magenta medium-size marker",
    "H": "large rectangular ridiculous pakistani exercise indigo leather bowl",

    "J": "brand-new plastic repulsive brazilian eating violet prismlike midsize bed",
}

def verdict(adjs):
    unknown_pairs = []
    for i in range(len(adjs)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(adjs)):
            a, b = CAT[adjs[i]], CAT[adjs[j]]
            if a == b:
                unknown_pairs.append((adjs[i], adjs[j]))
            elif (b, a) in edges:
                return "FAIL", f"{adjs[i]}({a}) before {adjs[j]}({b}) contradicts {b} < {a}"
            elif (a, b) not in edges:
                unknown_pairs.append((adjs[i], adjs[j]))
    if unknown_pairs:
        return "UNKNOWN", f"unresolved pairs {unknown_pairs}"
    return "PASS", "all pairs consistent with constraints"

results = {}
for key, text in OPTIONS.items():
    adjs = text.split()[:-1]  # drop head noun
    v, reason = verdict(adjs)
    results[key] = v
    print(f"{key}: {v} - {reason}")

correct = "".join(k for k in sorted(results) if results[k] == "PASS")
print("options determined correct:", correct or "none")

if "PASS" in results.values():
    print("K (none correct): CHECK FAIL - at least one option is fully consistent")
elif "UNKNOWN" in results.values():
    print("K (none correct): CHECK UNKNOWN - some options unresolved by sampled constraints")
else:
    print("K (none correct): CHECK PASS")
